emotional_tone: Trust, Authority, Clarity, and Distinctive Professionalism
instructions_to_main_agent: Redesign the sidebar for the ERP system. Use the 'Organic & Earthy' high-contrast theme to move away from the generic slate/blue/purple look. The design MUST fully support RTL (Arabic) and LTR (English) dynamically by strictly using Tailwind's logical properties. Build the sidebar out of raw HTML/Tailwind rather than overusing pre-packaged components to ensure exact styling, while you can use Shadcn for standard interactive bits like tooltips or collapsible areas if needed.

typography.english_fonts: IBM Plex Sans, Chivo, or Manrope

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid, low contrast on surfaces, crisp on active elements. Avoid heavy shadows. Use flat, structural separation.
visual_enhancers.active_states: Do not just fill the background. Use a subtle background tint AND a bold structural line on the inline-start (`border-s-2`) in the primary terracotta color.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Subtle translate on x-axis (`hover:translate-x-1` in LTR, `hover:-translate-x-1` in RTL) is tricky. Instead, rely on background tint, text brightening, and icon weight changes (Regular to Fill/Duotone).
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Not recommended for this ERP structure. Stick to 'Tactile/Neumorphism-lite' with sharp 1px borders to separate the sidebar from the main content area.

grids_and_layouts.sidebar_container: Fixed width `w-[280px] lg:w-[300px]`. Flex column layout, `h-screen`, `justify-between`.
grids_and_layouts.spacing_system: Use generous internal padding. Top logo area: `p-6`. Nav list: `px-4`. Bottom area: `p-6`.
grids_and_layouts.nested_lists: Sub-modules should be indented using logical properties (`ms-6`) and connected via a subtle `border-s` line.

company_plate.description: Top section containing the logo, company name, and subscription code.
company_plate.styles: Flex row, items-center, gap-3, pb-6 border-b border-border/60. Subscription code should be a micro-badge `text-[10px] bg-primary/10 text-primary px-2 py-0.5 rounded-sm`.

navigation_menu.description: Main list of modules (HR, Financial, E-Invoices, etc).
navigation_menu.styles: Flex column, gap-1. Items are `flex row items-center justify-between py-2.5 px-3 rounded-md transition-colors`. Icon on start, text, and chevron on end for expandable items.

user_profile_card.description: Bento-style card at the bottom above actions.
user_profile_card.styles: bg-surface border border-border rounded-xl p-3 flex flex-row items-center gap-3. Avatar should be a slightly rounded square (`rounded-lg`). Name is `text-sm font-medium`, Role badge is a micro-tag.

permissions_indicators.description: Green/red indicators showing allowed/not allowed status.
permissions_indicators.styles: Use Phosphor Icons (CheckCircle for allowed in `text-success`, Lock/Prohibit for denied in `text-error`). Keep them small (`w-4 h-4`) and elegantly placed next to module names if required.

bottom_actions.description: Grid or flex row for Dark Mode, Language Switcher, Settings, Logout.
bottom_actions.styles: Flex row, justify-between items-center pt-4 border-t border-border/60. Use icon-only square buttons `w-9 h-9 flex items-center justify-center rounded-md hover:bg-black/5 dark:hover:bg-white/5`.

rtl_ltr_rules.critical_warning: DO NOT USE left/right or pl/pr margins and paddings. The app dynamically switches dir='rtl' and dir='ltr'.
rtl_ltr_rules.flex_alignment: Flexbox naturally respects RTL. `flex-row items-center justify-between` will put the icon on the right and chevron on the left in RTL automatically.

motion.nav_expand: Use Framer Motion or smooth CSS transitions for sub-modules (`grid-template-rows` from 0fr to 1fr is a clean way to animate height without JS libraries).
motion.theme_switch: Add a smooth color transition `transition-colors duration-300` to the main sidebar wrapper.

image_urls.description: Man wearing blue dress shirt and gray waistcoat (Professional Avatar)
Minimalist geometric symbol on a blue background (Abstract Company Logo)

accessibility.focus_states: All interactive elements must have `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-primary focus-visible:ring-offset-2` (use `focus-visible:ring-offset-base_bg`).
accessibility.contrast: Ensure the text contrast against the #F7F7F5 light background and #141514 dark background passes APCA/WCAG standards.
accessibility.testing: Add `data-testid` attributes to all links, toggles, and buttons (e.g., `data-testid="nav-hr-module"`, `data-testid="lang-switcher-btn"`).

universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for a premium, crafted feel.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
Components MUST use named exports. Pages MUST use default exports.
